questions.q: What kind of place is the coast of Barbary?
choices: A green coast covered with palm-trees
A wild, lonely place of sand and stones
A busy harbor full of fishing-boats
A rocky shore with tall white cliffs
questions.evidence: It is a wild, lonely place--all sand and stones

questions.q: What did the Barbary pirates do to a ship after taking everything and the people off it?
choices: They sank it
They painted its sails red
They sold it to the King
They let it drift away

questions.q: How did Dab-Dab feel when she first saw the red sail far behind them?
choices: She was glad because she hoped they would get help
She thought it was the Prince coming to visit
She was too busy walking to pay it much mind
She had a feeling it was not a friendly ship
questions.evidence: I have a feeling it isn't a friendly ship

questions.q: What did Jip smell in his sleep at first?
choices: Fresh fish frying in a pan of butter
Bread baking in the palace-kitchen
Underdone roast beef with brown gravy
Salty seaweed drying on the rocks
questions.evidence: underdone roast beef--with brown gravy over it

questions.q: Jip said he smelled "six bad scoundrels fighting against one brave man." What does "scoundrels" mean?
choices: Sailors who are lost
Wicked, dishonest people
Brave soldiers
Tired old fishermen
questions.evidence: six bad scoundrels fighting against one brave man

questions.q: Why did Gub-Gub complain about the ship the Prince gave them?
choices: It was so slow they could not outrun the pirates
It was so small there was no room for the pig to sleep
It was leaking water through holes in the bottom
It had no food on it except dry, hard biscuits
questions.evidence: the slowest he could find, I should think

questions.q: What did the Doctor do after putting up all the sails did not help?
choices: He turned the ship around to fight the pirates
He told Jip to bark loudly to scare the men off
He threw the heavy boxes over the side of the ship
He sent Dab-Dab to ask the swallows what to do
questions.evidence: Then the Doctor asked Dab-Dab to fly up and tell the swallows

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: Jip learns how to smell things far away in his sleep
The Doctor and his animals capture a pirate ship
The swallows help the ship escape from the pirates
The pirates take the Doctor back to Barbary
questions.evidence: The red sails were being left far, far behind.
